caption: The drawing depicts an object consisting of two main parts: an upper section made of a gray metallic material with an intricate openwork design, featuring interlocking oval and looped shapes, and a robust lower section composed of a smoothly rounded, dark brown wooden handle. The metallic section is slightly wider at the top and narrows where it connects to the handle, and it also has several small round holes along its edge. The wooden handle is bulbous at the base, with a gradual taper and subtle wood grain texture, and is attached centrally to the metallic component. The background is a plain, light off-white color, and the object is centered within the composition.
title: Trivet
